notablePrerequisites: You control at least one land.
description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning any land to your hand from the battlefield, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Lotus Petal enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land enters the battlefield untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
